Fixes automatic-start installation when the OpenXR registry key is owned by SYSTEM, and removes the fixed LMU executable-hash restriction.

### Changes

- **Registry backup fix:** the elevated installer temporarily enables Windows' restore privilege to preserve the original owner and access rules when creating its backup and replacement key. Manual ownership changes or granting Users full control are unnecessary for this owner-copy error. Other registry write restrictions remain respected.

- **Executable compatibility:** the launcher, diagnostic CLI and native DLL accept different executable hashes. Native hook-signature and resource checks remain active. Run diagnostics record the actual executable SHA256.

### Updating

Extract the complete package. Close LMU before choosing **Setup > Install / update automatic startup** from the new launcher. Keep the extracted folder in place and use Steam's OpenXR launch mode as before.

### Validation

The SYSTEM-owned registry backup failure was reproduced in an isolated test key. Installation and injected rollback now preserve ownership, access rules, layer order and values. Alpha-branch rendering compatibility is not established by removing the hash restriction; incompatible native code signatures still stop hook installation.
